# reel-skill

> A Claude Code skill that turns raw video footage into a postable, vertical
> (9:16) Instagram Reel: it picks the best moments from a folder of clips,
> writes the on-screen copy and caption, renders the cut with ffmpeg, and
> critiques its own result against a rubric before handing it back.

Install with `npx reel-skill`, which copies the skill into
`.claude/skills/reel/` in the current folder for use with Claude Code.

Everything runs locally through ffmpeg. No footage, copy, or captions are
uploaded to any third-party service by the skill itself, and it does not
post to Instagram or any other platform.

## Key files

- [README.md](README.md): install instructions, how the pipeline works, FAQ
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): the instructions Claude follows to run the skill
- [PLAYBOOK.md](PLAYBOOK.md): reel formats and copy formulas
- [RUBRIC.md](RUBRIC.md): the scoring criteria Claude reviews its own renders against
- [examples/new-year-2027.json](examples/new-year-2027.json): a worked example of the edit schema
